snippet.title: Crossed Commands: Collision Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Into the Breach has been a major inspiration for me, and I have so much respect for its creators. This is my love letter to that kind of thoughtful, turn-based strategy.

You'll control nimble mechs in fast-paced tactical duels. Outsmart your enemies, use the terrain to your advantage, and turn their strength against them. After each battle, collect parts to build and customize your own unique mech, then take on even bigger challenges.

What you need to run it:

OS: Windows 10 or newer

CPU: Dual-core 2.8 GHz or better

RAM: 1 GB

Graphics: DirectX 9.1+ or OpenGL 3.2+

Storage: 500 MB free space This video contains gameplay footage of the game mentioned in the title. 
The gameplay is recorded and shared for commentary, review, and educational purposes. 
All rights to the game and its content belong to the respective copyright holders. 
Music and sound effects that may trigger Content ID have been removed or replaced where possible. 
If you are a copyright holder and have concerns, please contact me directly before submitting a claim.
